title: Shinobi Gaiden
description: Shinobi Gaiden Official Minecraft modpack to help enhance the RP experience on the Shinobi Gaiden Server.
body:
# Currently On Hiatus With No Current Return Date. # 🌿 SHINOBI GAIDEN MC 🌿 Naruto Inspired Minecraft RPG / RP Server Hello! We're Shinobi Gaiden — a Minecraft Naruto RPG/RP server that has been in development for nearly 2 years. With the help of 40+ staff members and an amazing community, we’ve built a near-scale recreation of the Naruto world in Minecraft — featuring a custom timeline, custom models, and original story elements. ### 🔥 What We Offer - 🗺️ Custom Built Map - ⚔️ Combat & Questing Systems (WIP) - 🌀 Custom Weapons & Equipment (WIP) - 👹 Unique Enemies & Bosses (WIP) - 📖 Original Storyline - 🎮 Mini Games (In Development) - 🌎 Dedicated SMP (In Development) ### 📢 Recruiting - Hosts - Lore Writers - Builders - Moderators - And more ## 🔗 How To Join ### 🌐 Website: https://shinobigaidenrp.com ### 💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/shinobigaiden If the website is ever down, all information can be found in our Discord.
🎥 Videos
Become part of the next generation of shinobi.

The Lite edition is recommended for those with lower end computers, but both editions have performance enhancers.

We have also provided recommended shaderpacks for those who like that kind of thing pre installed, as well as two resource packs: Gaiden Tweaks, which adds a few visual effects, and a smooth font pack. Both of these are optional.
